semantics: Per published id: the latest count WINDOW ("YYYY-MM" or "YYYY-MM_YYYY-MM", the source's own snapshot id) in which each rolling FLOW register counted it, and the register's raw spellings that landed on it (`raw`). A later build whose window no longer counts the id keeps that country in `availability` marked `last_observed` - and keeps the id published if no flow register counts it now - for 12 months after the window's last month, while curation still routes those spellings to the id. No counts; written only from published records; removals.yml, former_ids.yml and demotions.yml always win and drop the entry.
